subject.title: feat(telegram): send voice typing cue before transcription

question: Should maintainers require live Telegram proof before considering this transport-visible typing-cue PR mergeable, or intentionally accept source-ordering and focused tests as sufficient?
rationale: The code path and unit tests support the intended ordering, but the scoped Telegram policy and user-visible nature of the cue make real Telegram proof the unresolved merge gate.

options.title: Require live Telegram proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, bot log, live output, or equivalent proof shows the cue before transcription or before the agent reply on the current head.

options.title: Accept source-ordering evidence
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge after conflict resolution based on source ordering and focused tests, owning the risk that the Telegram client still does not visibly show the cue soon enough.

recommendation.title: Require live Telegram proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, bot log, live output, or equivalent proof shows the cue before transcription or before the agent reply on the current head.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent adjacent Telegram context history make steipete the best available routing owner for this proof-sufficiency choice.
